author: getintoai
text:
@gregisenberg spent 48 hours in San Francisco hanging out with billionaires, AI founders, data labs, and startup execs. His takeaways are pretty wild.

He says AI companies are already doing massive revenue, founders are betting hard on agents, internal company data could become incredibly valuable, and the way software gets built is changing fast.

One of the biggest themes was agents. Not just chatbots, but systems that can actually watch your work, use tools, move across apps, and complete tasks with much less human input.

He also pointed out that a lot of the next big opportunities may come from company data, memory, cybersecurity, internal AI tools, and startups rebuilding old software around agents.

The interesting part is that a lot of this is already happening behind closed doors.

Swipe through for all his takeaways.

Follow @getintoai for more.
